verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee is a web-scraping API service, not an agent or AI host that consumes external tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product role. The evidence shows only an official MCP server (mcp.scrapingbee.com), which exposes ScrapingBee to other agents. That is the server role and does not show the product can plug in external MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
